title: The Limits of GDP and the Measure of Well-Being
chineseTitle: GDP 指标的局限性与国民幸福福祉（Well-Being）综合考量
topic: 宏观经济学与社会福祉 / 英国脱欧、GDP 指标缺陷与国民福祉（Well-being）综合考量
overview: 本文以罗伯特·肯尼迪对 GDP 的经典批判和英国脱欧公投为切入点，深刻反思了单纯将 GDP 视作国家成功唯一标准的严重局限。实证研究显示，英国 GDP 数据虽曾领先西方，但在将增长转化为国民实际福祉上却严重垫底，医疗教育持续下滑。文章强调 GDP 无法涵盖环境质量与教育成效等构成幸福感的核心要素，大声疾呼富国决策者必须深切汲取教训，将精力重心全面转向考量超越 GDP 以外的诸多国民福祉综合指标。

syntax_analysis.english: With Britain voting to leave the European Union, and GDP already predicted to slow as a result, it is now a timely moment to assess what he was referring to.
syntax_analysis.chinese: 随着英国公投决定脱离欧盟，且GDP也已断定将因之下滑，此时正是考量其话语所指的最佳时机。
syntax_analysis.structureType: with复合结构作状语+形式主语句+宾语从句
syntax_analysis.mainClause: it is now a timely moment to assess what he was referring to.（it 为形式主语，不定式短语 to assess... 为真正主语）
syntax_analysis.modifiers: With Britain voting... and GDP already predicted... 为两个并列的 with 复合独立主格结构作伴随状语；what he was referring to 为宾语从句作 assess 的宾语。
syntax_analysis.corePattern: With + n. + doing/done（随着……）；It is a timely moment to do sth.（正是做某事的适宜时机）；refer to（指的是）。

syntax_analysis.english: If everything was going so well, then why did over 17 million people vote for Brexit, despite the warnings about what it could do to their country's economic prospects?
syntax_analysis.chinese: 倘若一切都进展得如此喜人，那为何尽管已有警示表明脱欧将会影响本国经济，还是有1700多万人投票支持脱欧？
syntax_analysis.structureType: 条件状语从句+特殊疑问句+介词短语及宾语从句
syntax_analysis.mainClause: why did over 17 million people vote for Brexit...
syntax_analysis.modifiers: If everything was going so well 为条件状语从句；despite the warnings about... 为让步状语；what it could do to their country's economic prospects 为宾语从句作 about 的宾语。
syntax_analysis.corePattern: vote for sth.（投票赞成某事）；despite the warnings about...（尽管有关于……的警告）。

syntax_analysis.english: Across the 163 countries measured, the UK is one of the poorest performers in ensuring that economic growth is translated into meaningful improvements for its citizens.
syntax_analysis.chinese: 在所有被测量的163个国家中，英国是在“确保经济增长转化为有意义的民生改善”方面表现最差的国家之一。
syntax_analysis.structureType: 主系表结构+介词短语+宾语从句
syntax_analysis.mainClause: the UK is one of the poorest performers...
syntax_analysis.modifiers: Across the 163 countries measured 为范围状语，measured 为后置定语；in ensuring that... 作方式/领域状语；that economic growth is translated into... 为宾语从句作 ensuring 的宾语。
syntax_analysis.corePattern: one of the poorest performers in doing（在做……方面表现最差之一）；translate A into B（将A转化为B）。

syntax_analysis.english: Rather than just focusing on GDP, over 40 different sets of criteria from health, education and civil society engagement have been measured to get a more rounded assessment of how countries are performing.
syntax_analysis.chinese: 此次研究并非只关注GDP，而是涵盖了健康、教育和公民社会参与度领域的40多组不同指标，意在对各国表现做出更全面的评估。
syntax_analysis.structureType: 状语从句缩略+被动语态主干+目的状语及宾语从句
syntax_analysis.mainClause: over 40 different sets of criteria... have been measured...
syntax_analysis.modifiers: Rather than just focusing on GDP 作否定状语；from health, education and civil society engagement 作定语修饰 criteria；to get a more rounded assessment... 作目的状语；of how countries are performing 为介词宾语从句。
syntax_analysis.corePattern: Rather than doing sth.（与其做某事/并非……）；rounded assessment（全面综合的评估）。

syntax_analysis.english: Yes, there has been a budding economic recovery since the 2008 global crash, but in key indicators in areas such as health and education, major economies have continued to decline.
syntax_analysis.chinese: 的确，自2008年全球危机以来，经济已经有了复苏的苗头；但就健康和教育这类领域的关键指标而言，主要经济体的表现持续下滑。
syntax_analysis.structureType: but连接的并列转折复合句
syntax_analysis.mainClause: there has been a budding economic recovery... but major economies have continued to decline.
syntax_analysis.modifiers: since the 2008 global crash 作时间状语；in key indicators in areas such as... 作领域状语修饰后半句。
syntax_analysis.corePattern: a budding recovery（初露苗头的复苏）；continue to decline（持续下滑）。

syntax_analysis.english: So, what Kennedy was referring to was that while GDP has been the most common method for measuring the economic activity of nations, as a measure, it is no longer enough.
syntax_analysis.chinese: 因此，肯尼迪所要指的是：尽管GDP一直是衡量国家经济活动最常用的方法，但作为一种衡量标准，它已不足以担此重任。
syntax_analysis.structureType: 主语从句+系动词+表语从句（内含让步状语从句）
syntax_analysis.mainClause: what Kennedy was referring to was that... it is no longer enough.
syntax_analysis.modifiers: what Kennedy was referring to 为 what 引导的主语从句；that 引导表语从句；while GDP has been... 为让步状语从句；as a measure 作插入语。
syntax_analysis.corePattern: what sb. was referring to was that...（某人所指的其实是……）；no longer enough（不再充足/不再管用）。

syntax_analysis.english: But policymakers who refocus efforts on improving well-being rather than simply worrying about GDP figures could avoid the forecasted doom and may even see progress.
syntax_analysis.chinese: 但，政策制定者们应重新集中精力于提升（社会）福利，而非仅仅忧心GDP数字；如此才有可能避免预期的灾难，甚至取得进步。
syntax_analysis.structureType: 定语从句修饰主语+并列谓语复合句
syntax_analysis.mainClause: policymakers could avoid the forecasted doom and may even see progress.
syntax_analysis.modifiers: who refocus efforts on improving well-being rather than simply worrying about GDP figures 为限制性定语从句修饰 policymakers；rather than 连接两个并列动名词短语。
syntax_analysis.corePattern: refocus efforts on sth.（将精力重新聚焦于某事）；avoid the forecasted doom（避免预见的灾难）。
